A vast writhing mass of soft glowing tentacles, dozens of translucent fleshy limbs unfurling from a central pulpy body-core, each limb lined with rows of bioluminescent suckers radiating warm cyan light into the dark.

A colossal anemone-bloom of thousands of waving fleshy fronds, soft and luminous, anchored to a central gelatinous stalk, travelling waves of pink-gold bioluminescence rippling outward through every frond continuously.

A drifting ribbon-creature of living membrane, kilometers long and paper-thin, its translucent body rippling in slow sinuous waves, bioluminescent veins branching across its surface glowing deep violet against the black of space.

A translucent sac-body, enormous and softly rounded, a single colossal glowing heart-organ suspended at its center by pale membranous strands, the outer skin faintly luminous and slowly contracting with each deep pulse.

A many-tendrilled drifting medusa with a vast domed translucent crown, the dome filled with slowly churning glowing fluid, hundreds of long fleshy tendrils hanging below, tipped with bright bioluminescent bulbs of deep teal.

A cloud-soft organism studded across its entire surface with dozens of glowing eye-spots, each eye a soft luminous disc of shifting amber, the body itself a loose drifting mass of pale translucent living tissue.

A colossal flower-creature of fleshy luminous petals, each petal broad and softly translucent, veined with bioluminescent gold, slowly opening and closing around a bright central organ-cluster that pulses with deep rose-colored light.

A drifting mass of soft membranous lobes, dozens of rounded fleshy bulges clustered together like a living coral head, each lobe glowing a different hue of blue-green from organs visible just beneath the translucent skin.

A vast pale organism shaped like a soft billowing mantle, its edges deeply fringed with thousands of short fleshy cilia, undulating continuously, the whole mantle glowing faint silver-blue as internal fluids shift and flow.

A colossal soft-bodied creature trailing a corona of hundreds of long luminous filaments, each filament a living tendril of glowing membrane tipped with a tiny pulsing light-organ, the central body a gentle domed translucent mass.

A colossal translucent polyp-form, its body a soft elongated sac with a wide fleshy crown of waving oral tentacles, each tentacle banded with rings of pale gold bioluminescence, the sac-body slowly contracting and expanding.

A vast drifting organism of soft living velvet-flesh, its body surface covered in millions of tiny pulsing papillae each tipped with a point of cyan light, the combined glow surrounding the creature in a soft luminous haze.

A ribbon-thin organism of colossal size, its soft membranous body folded into enormous slow spirals, glowing blue filaments running along every edge, the creature slowly unspooling and re-coiling in long graceful living waves.

A soft translucent sphere of enormous scale, living tissue pressed against its inner surface, a tangle of glowing organs drifting at the center, the outer membrane studded with short fleshy protrusions pulsing with warm violet light.

A vast soft organism whose body is a loose congregation of membranous wings, each wing a broad translucent flap of living tissue veined with glowing fluid, the wings slowly beating in long sweeping strokes through void.

A colossal living siphonophore-form, a colonial soft-bodied creature stretched across kilometers, each translucent zooid unit glowing its own hue, the whole chain pulsing in coordinated waves of bioluminescent light from end to end.

A great drifting mass of soft luminous flesh shaped loosely like a bloom, its outer surface covered in long fleshy cilia waving continuously, inner organs glowing orange-amber visible through translucent skin in slow churning motion.

A colossal translucent creature whose body is a single vast soft membrane folded into deep living pleats, bioluminescent fluid pooling in each fold glowing pale teal, the entire pleated organism slowly breathing open and closed.
